reviews.comment: Genuinely sweet and caring guy. He was a pretty chill grader and only a couple of assignments in the class. Lectures pretty repetitive but just tune it out.

I decided to take Dorsey's course as I thought it would be fun and wouldn't be too difficult. Turns out, I was incorrect. Whether it's the tedious way of grading, or his inability to answer questions without reverting to "read the instructions", Dorsey is a professor that does not care about his students or how well they do. No extra credit offered
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He used straw man arguments on complex issues, on a daily basis but justifies it by claiming hes looking through a specific rhetorical lens, which completely takes away from the narrative of the class which is to use reason and consult all evidence .One day, I asked for the website of the article he cited in class, and he replied look it up

I really liked this class, and it is not that difficult. Exams (2) are open note and open book. Write down EVERYTHING he says in lecture because it will really matter on the exams. Really take the time to think about the reading assignments and analysis papers because the grading is a little tough. Excellent feedback on papers so you can improve!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: professor dorsey is more intimidating than difficult. he's very knowledgable about content area

He was an excellent professor and I actually enjoyed his class. There were 2 exams, one personal essay, and one teacher assigned 4 person group essay. He graded kind of hard on the essays, but he does allow you to read some of his own articles for reference on what is expected. Exams were online and not too difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dorsey is a great professor. His instructions are vague so ask in detail and he will answer; make sure you know what you're doing because there are only a few grades. DO THE READINGS and make sure to analyze the concepts. I didn't do any of the readings and bombed the 1st test. Write down EVERYTHING HE SAYS because it'll most likely be on the test
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dorsey is super cool but there's not much the final grade is made of. The tests were online and open notes but make sure you write down every word he said, it matters! Make sure to actually listen, he has some interesting topics and is pretty funny if you get his references. Be ready to analyze some challenging things.

It was an interesting class but pretty difficult. Attendance is not mandatory but I mean it.. GO.. You will not do well on the tests if not. Pay attention to his slides and examples and do the readings. If you get put in a bad group you can get screwed too so make sure and communicate. His instructions are vague so go to office hours

The course was overall doable and easy to manage. Do go to lectures and take notes, exams are online but involve readings and lectures. The group project is a little bit of a pain to manage but again doable. Do ya work, go to class, study plain and simple.

Comm 340 with Dorsey was a great class with super interesting lectures. The tests are online but actually pretty hard but mostly from notes in the lectures. I missed a lot but still was able to do well. 1 group project paper and 1 on paper on your own but totally doable!!

I don't recommend you take this class unless you're actually a comms major. I'm engineering but I took this for a creatives arts credit and it's a lot of work. He gives quizzes that only have 2 questions and if you don't read the book (super boring) you're screwed. Also if you get stuck with a bad group for the project, there goes your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dorsey is probably my favorite prof I've had. His lectures are incredible because he knows his stuff and is passionate about the material. The group project is not bad, but get ready to put in work esp. if you don't get a great group. If you go to class (yes, every class) and work hard, you can make a good grade. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Funny and shows a lot of examples. If you go to class and take notes you will perform good on the tests because everything he says in class is on the tests
Awesome professor! He wants you to learn, but make sure to write down everything he says! Tests are open note, and most questions are from what he said not from what was on the power points.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Dorsey the most entertaining professor I've had. He's good at keeping you engaged in the topics. He can be kind of vague with his definitions so it makes it pretty difficult to grasp on to his concepts sometimes. There are a lot of readings for this class, and writing down what he says (not just what's on his slides) is pretty important.

Coming into Dorsey's class he told us this would be the easiest class we would take in college. If you attend all lectures, then the notes you go over in class can be used towards your online tests that you take wherever you want. You have one group project. Very easy class. You go over very controversial topics in society so expect discussion.

His lectures were really interesting and he kept my attention the whole time. That's a good thing too, because the exams don't have a lot of stuff from the readings and are mostly over the lectures. Just make sure to go to class and take notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love this guy, he is great, and I LOVED HIS LECTURES, and if you take good notes you WILL have a good grade in his class. I did not receive an A because of the final group project (bad groupmates). This class is apparently meant for juniors and seniors but i took at as a freshman and it was completely fine. It is fun and i always had a good laugh

Amazing lectures but you better type notes (every word) and use ctrl f if you want to do well on tests. Open note tests, class is much better for students who are big into movies and tv. Group project is difficult, esp. if you are trying to carry the group. Sometimes hard to get answers to questions. Get ready to read 3-6 long articles per test.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are open note and open book, but are extremely tricky. His lectures reinforce the readings with many examples, so if you decide to skip class do not expect a passing grade. His lectures are very entertaining because of the everyday examples he gives to help you understand theories. Very funny too! The final group project is pretty tough.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Dorsey is one of my favorite professors at A&M. His lectures are very intriguing and fun to listen to. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if you want a good grade you should not skip class. His exams are tricky because his lectures provide answers to the exams that the textbook doesn't provide. He makes you work, but you learn so much.
